body: MagnaCarta 2 is Softmax's Xbox 360 role-playing game, first released in South Korea on 6 August 2009. Juto becomes involved with Zephie and the conflict around her, entering a story whose larger history he does not initially understand. The game continues the Magna Carta name with a new adventure built for seventh-generation console hardware. Exploration moves directly into battles on the field, keeping the party within the same surroundings. Its combat combines active movement with systems that make the timing of a character change important to the progress of an encounter.

The player moves between an exploration stance and a slower combat stance, choosing when to engage the enemies nearby. Three characters can be active, with others available to replace them. Normal attacks and abilities interact with Kan, the energy used by special actions, giving the party another resource to manage alongside health. The player has to consider how one character's activity affects the next. A useful sequence involves more than staying with the strongest fighter, since changing control can help the group sustain its actions through a longer confrontation.

The game uses Unreal Engine 3, with character art and presentation forming a prominent part of Softmax's approach to the console generation. Sung-woon Jang directed its sound and composed the music. Namco Bandai published the release, which reached Japan shortly after South Korea and North America and Europe in October 2009. It remained exclusive to Xbox 360. MagnaCarta 2 offers another perspective on that console's role-playing catalogue, bringing a Korean-developed series into the same international market where Microsoft was also promoting projects from established Japanese studios.
